scripts.deploy: npm run config && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.gen.jsonc --var "CACHE_VERSION:$(date +%s)" "STEAM_ID:$STEAM_ID" "DISCORD_ID:$DISCORD_ID" "LINKEDIN_URL:$LINKEDIN_URL"
